caption: A cat crawls under a blanket on a bed, and a moving lump travels across the blanket to the far edge, where the cat comes out.

sa.check: A cat crawls under a blanket on a bed.
A moving lump travels across the blanket.
The cat comes out at the far edge.
The crawl in comes first, then the lump, then the emergence.

pc.expect: The cat emerges only at the edge, and it is the same cat.
pc.fail: It appears elsewhere; or two cats; or it vanishes for good.

pc.expect: The cat is not visible through the blanket and the lump is its size.
pc.fail: It shows through; or passes through the top of the blanket; or the lump is the wrong size.
It jumps; or splits; or the lump keeps moving while the cat is out.

pc.expect: The blanket drapes over the lump.
pc.fail: It is rigid; or stretches; or tears.
It splits; or merges with the blanket; or turns into another animal.

pc.expect: The blanket's pattern and the bed stay the same.
pc.fail: The pattern changes; or the bed changes; or the room rearranges.

note: The cat is self-driven: its path under the blanket is its own. Only containment and the lump are judged.
